abstract: Some industry innovators are jacks of all trades and masters of all of them. Tami Kusvabadika, Head of Media Operations at AfricaXP, is such an innovator, working in nearly all aspects of media except acting. His contributions to film have led him all over the world, from South Africa to Canada, and his work has opened doors and created countless industry opportunities for students and early-career professionals.
